assertions.description: 'gateway.port' is ignored by every platform (nginx hardcodes 80; the cloud gateways have no listen-port concept) and was deleted from the config model. Scoped to a 'port' key immediately inside a 'gateway {}' block so it does not false-positive on unrelated 'port' fields (zitadelIdentity.port, RDBMS pooled-group ports, etc.).
